author: More Perfect Union
description:
Your tax dollars are funding Trump’s July 4th spectacle, while his cronies cash in on no-bid contracts.

From gold-plated horse statues to the reflecting pool fiasco, we tracked down how Trump turned America’s 250th birthday into a giant slush fund for his inner circle.

Producer: Meagan Day
Editor: @discosludge
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: How Trump turned July 4 into a slush fund for his cronies
